name: smart-l1
description: The skills that turn a WHO publication into L1: building the DAK's L1 library, extracting recommendations, remarks and indicators verbatim, checking transcriptions made from pictures, GRADE, and classifying and coding L1 content. Split out of `authoring-who-smart-guidelines` by layer (issue #359); the stack-wide skills (the end-to-end process, creating a guideline, the stack's layering, toolchain ownership, the smart-base tools) stay there.
